findings.evidence: `Covering.lean:107` declares `UniversalCover.pathConnectedSpace (x₀ : X)` with no hypotheses, while Mathlib `Topology/Covering/Basic.lean:368` shows `eq_of_comp_eq` needs only a preconnected source plus the covering map’s local injectivity. The global assumption enters here solely through `isCoveringMap x₁` (`Covering.lean:46`).
findings.fix: Remove `[PathConnectedSpace X]`; expose/use the local-homeomorphism or local-injectivity property of `proj` under only `[LocallyPathConnectedSpace X] [SemilocallySimplyConnectedSpace X]` and apply the same connected-domain uniqueness argument.
findings.issue: `eq_basepointChangeHomeomorph` assumes `[PathConnectedSpace X]`, a global condition irrelevant to uniqueness on `UniversalCover x₀`, which is path-connected without assumptions.

summary: The uniqueness theorem unnecessarily requires the entire base space to be path-connected, although only the component containing the supplied path is involved.
